gospelsChronological.longDescription: Experience the life and ministry of Jesus through a chronological journey across all four Gospel accounts. This harmonized reading follows the biblical timeline from Jesus' birth to His resurrection, providing a cohesive narrative of Christ's ministry.

adventJourneyChronological.title: Advent Journey
adventJourneyChronological.longDescription: Read Advent the way the church has kept it for centuries. Week 1 traces God's promise through Jesus' family tree, week 2 listens to the prophets, and week 3 rejoices. From December 17 the ancient O Antiphons lead day by day to Christmas Eve. Sunday readings include the passage many churches read that day.

jesusFilmChronological.title: Jesus Film (Chronological)

This chronological journey follows the 12 key stories that bring the film to life, from the miraculous birth of John the Baptist to the resurrection. Discover how Luke's unique perspective as a Gentile physician captures Jesus' compassion for all people and His mission to bring salvation to the world.
